behaviors: The unchanged v1 engine pack digest and migration 017 digest remain exact
A strict full-spectrum Division 23 v2 semantic pack compiles to order-independent canonical bytes and SHA-256 identity
All fourteen definition kinds and ten relation kinds carry resolved per-assertion citations
The five reserved executable arrays are present and empty; non-empty executable content fails closed in B1
A dedicated SQLite EngineStore creates exactly seven v2 user tables and rejects P0, P1A, v1, and unknown schemas
Canonical pack bytes are authoritative, immutable, idempotently imported, reopenable, and queryable by source, definition, relation, neighbor, and citation
Pack supersession is pack-level, same-code, earlier-version lineage and never an in-pack relation
Projection deletion and rebuild reproduce exact indexes while appending one chained event
Migration, blob, projection, citation, endpoint, and event tampering fails closed
The wheel packages v2 schema and migration resources while excluding Build Fabric code and state

capability: Build the first usable database-first Division 23 v2 semantic and provenance registry across equipment, duct, pipe, fittings, valves, accessories, materials, connections, insulation, supports, labor, pricing, and rule candidates.

block.action: Block acceptance; do not label fixture content production knowledge.
block.when: The bundled TEST_FIXTURE source is described as verified or production-authoritative.

escalation.action: Report the exact failing behavior and redesign once; do not enter a repeated full-suite loop.
escalation.when: The single consolidated acceptance gate fails after a substantive implementation attempt.

reroute.action: Create an explicit replacement task and assignment without relabeling another provider's work.
reroute.when: The identified external builder cannot complete the bounded task.

stop.when: The patch writes P0/P1A/v1 facts, quantities, pricing decisions, approvals, bids, drawings, or research-provider state.

deliverables: Strict Division 23 v2 semantic pack contracts and compiler
Query, reopen, projection rebuild, lineage, and integrity behavior
Packaged v2 schema and migration resources with v1 compatibility
frozen_interfaces: DefinitionKind, DomainFamily, RelationKind, DefinitionRecord, RelationRecord, CitationRecord, CompiledDomainPack, StoreIntegrityReport
Domain pack top-level fields include sources, definitions, relations and five required empty executable arrays
Pack supersession exists only through supersedes_pack_sha256
Exactly seven engine v2 user tables
